text: Entering this pristine, brightly-lit space, I feel a sense of anticipation mingled with curiosity. There is a clinical orderliness here, almost sterile, yet offset by the colorful display that hints at creativity and innovation. The "R&D" installation draws me into a reflective mood, prompting thoughts on humanity's perpetual drive to discover, research, and advance. I feel slightly out of place, yet compelled to ponder the relationship between sterile environments and imaginative expression.
